meta.name: opencode-notebooklm
meta.description: 連接 NotebookLM，讓 OpenCode 讀寫 Google NotebookLM 筆記本。說「連接 NotebookLM」「裝 NotebookLM」時載入。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用OpenCode编码且需要访问NotebookLM笔记
copy.tagline_en: Read and write Google NotebookLM notes from OpenCode
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with OpenCode and manage research notes in NotebookLM

howto.what: Claude 能通过 OpenCode 连接 Google NotebookLM，创建笔记本、上传资料，生成简报、图表、音频、视频、思维导图、测验等，并将成果自动下载到本地指定文件夹。
howto.when: 当你说出「连接 NotebookLM」「装 NotebookLM」等触发词时，技能被激活。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新笔记本，上传这份PDF
列出我所有的 NotebookLM 笔记本
say.note: Claude 会从 NotebookLM 读取笔记本列表。

howto.what_en: Claude gains the ability to operate Google NotebookLM via OpenCode: create notebooks, upload sources, generate slide decks, infographics, audio overviews, video overviews, mindmaps, quizzes, etc., and automatically download outputs to a local folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like "connect NotebookLM" or "install NotebookLM". The skill loads on these keywords.

say_en.note: Activates the skill; Claude attempts to connect to NotebookLM.

say_en.text: Create a new notebook and upload this PDF
say_en.note: Claude creates a notebook in NotebookLM and uploads the file.
Claude retrieves the notebook list from NotebookLM.
